inputs.name: conn3x_ui_version
inputs.description: conn3x-ui release to install, without the leading v. Null means the default.

inputs.name: conn3x_ui_checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the conn3x-ui release archive for each architecture, from the release's checksums.txt. Change these with conn3x_ui_version. Null means the default.

inputs.name: conn3x_version
inputs.description: Conn3x release the UI runs plans and applies with, without the leading v. A project can name another binary. Null means the default.

inputs.name: conn3x_checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the conn3x release archive for each architecture, from the release's checksums.txt. Change these with conn3x_version. Null means the default.

inputs.name: listen
inputs.description: Address the UI listens on. Keep it on loopback and put a TLS proxy in front to reach it from elsewhere: off localhost, the session cookie needs https.

inputs.name: extra_args
inputs.description: More flags for conn3x-ui serve, such as the -oidc-* ones for single sign-on. Each one is passed as a single argument, as written. Keep secrets out: use -oidc-client-secret-file.
